description: Publish a NEW version to an existing Modrinth project by uploading one or more built jar files. This is a write action that publishes public content — only call it when the user has explicitly asked to publish. The project must already exist on Modrinth.

dependencies.description: Dependencies. e.g. Fabric API as required: [{project_id:'P7dR8mSH', dependency_type:'required'}].

file_paths.description: Absolute path(s) to the jar file(s) to upload. First is treated as the primary file.

loaders.description: Mod loaders, e.g. ['fabric']. Defaults to fabric.

project_id.description: Target project slug or id (must already exist).

name: modrinth_create_version
